builds.name: Reference: Ranked mid core
builds.goal: Reference for Annie: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ mid players use most (2,022 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 56.5% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A compact burst-and-control mage who prepares a stun, threatens a close-range initiation, and can protect an ally with her shield. The current mid provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Malignance → Hextech Rocketbelt → Shadowflame. Electrocute keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Sorcerer's Shoes, Zhonya's Hourglass, Rabadon's Deathcap.
builds.summary: The proven mid baseline: Malignance → Hextech Rocketbelt → Shadowflame, with Electrocute.
testPlan: Play it in mid as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Malignance → Hextech Rocketbelt → Shadowflame) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 56.5% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Malignance → Hextech Rocketbelt → Shadowflame.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Annie gains [(0.1 / 0.15 / 0.2) × 100]% Magic Penetration.

Annie summons her bear Tibbers, dealing [150 / 275 / 400 + (0.75) × AP] magic damage. For the next [45] seconds, Tibbers burns nearby enemies for [8 / 12 / 16 + (0.04) × AP] magic damage per second.

Tibbers becomes enraged when summoned, if Annie stuns an enemy champion, and if Annie dies. When enraged, Tibbers gains 275% Attack Speed and 100% Move Speed decaying over 3 seconds.

Recast: Manually issue orders to Tibbers.

After using 4 Abilities, Annie's next damaging Ability Stuns for [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=1.25, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.25, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.25, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds.

Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.
Annie hurls a fireball, dealing [80 / 125 / 170 / 215 / 260 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage. If the target dies, Annie refunds the Mana cost and reduces the Cooldown by 50%.

Annie grants an ally champion [60 / 95 / 130 / 165 / 200 + (0.4) × AP] Shield for [3] seconds and [characterLevelInterpolation(0.2 → 0.5; raw flags preserved)] Decaying Move Speed for [1.5] seconds. While the shield holds, enemies who hit the shielded ally with an Attack or Ability receive [25 / 35 / 45 / 55 / 65 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage once per shield.

Tibbers always gains the effects of Molten Shield when summoned.
Annie projects a wave of fire, dealing [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.

builds.name: Shield Retaliation Heal
builds.summary: Log Helia storage and healing over two E casts.
builds.goal: Log Helia storage and healing over two E casts.
builds.hypothesis: E shields an ally and retaliates once per enemy per shield. Helia can store champion damage before a later allied shield; Staff rewards the shield. Q stun and initial R damage can fill charges without assuming Tibbers inherits items.
testPlan: Required state: Deal champion damage before shielding another ally.
Log Helia storage and healing over two E casts; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Shield gets consumed before useful retaliation or charges are spent too early.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: One enemy cannot trigger unlimited E retaliation.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Echoes of Helia, Staff of Flowing Water, Imperial Mandate, Rabadon's Deathcap, Redemption, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Survive the engage
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Annie: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A compact burst-and-control mage who prepares a stun, threatens a close-range initiation, and can protect an ally with her shield. Measure prepared-stun burst and Tibbers contact separately from a shielding support route. Do not assume pet damage triggers every item effect on every tick. A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts.
builds.summary: A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts.
testPlan: Kit question for Annie: Measure prepared-stun burst and Tibbers contact separately from a shielding support route. Do not assume pet damage triggers every item effect on every tick.

Start with the early core (Archangel, then the defense matching the opponent) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Annie hurls a Mana infused fireball, dealing damage and refunding the Mana cost if it destroys the target. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Defensive redundancy can sacrifice too much damage; this is conditional on real threats.

The route fails Annie's stated kit question: Measure prepared-stun burst and Tibbers contact separately from a shielding support route. Do not assume pet damage triggers every item effect on every tick.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Defensive redundancy can sacrifice too much damage; this is conditional on real threats.
Full cost 16,000 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Archangel, then the defense matching the opponent. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Banshee's Veil, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Void Staff are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.summary: Measure Tibbers time in range during summon and a later stun.
builds.goal: Measure Tibbers time in range during summon and a later stun.
builds.hypothesis: R enrages Tibbers on summon and Annie stuns. Later Pyromania Q/W can renew the attack-speed window; Rylai tests qualifying ability slow retention and Cosmic moves Annie. AP supports initial R/burn and Zhonya preserves controller survival.

Measure Tibbers time in range during summon and a later stun; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
